apparel_sarees.note: Weekday sales are normally about 85% of weekend sales for saree/apparel retailers in tier-2 cities. A ratio below 0.65 for 2+ consecutive weeks indicates an anomaly worth flagging, not seasonal noise.
common_causes_of_weekday_dip: Reduced footfall due to local construction/roadwork
Stock gap in a popular price band

grocery_kirana.note: Kirana demand is fairly flat across the week since it serves daily essentials; a >20% single-day drop usually means a stockout of a high-frequency SKU, not demand softness.

food_qsr.note: QSR volumes peak on weekends and evenings; a healthy outlet sees 25-40% of monthly revenue in a compact evening window (7-9pm).

salon_wellness.note: Salons are heavily weekend and appointment-driven; weekday utilization below 40% of capacity is normal, but a sudden drop in repeat-customer visit frequency is the metric that matters more than daily revenue.
